correctness.rationale: Represent n-length binary words of weight three by four nonnegative zero gaps x0..x3 with sum N=n-3. All eight length-three scattered subsequence multiplicities are determined by N, A=T011=3x0+x1, B=T110=x2+3x3, and F=T001=sum_i binom(p_i,2) with prefix-zero counts p1=x0,p2=x0+x1,p3=x0+x1+x2. Equal N,A,B implies xprime=x+t(1,-3,3,-1). The exact F difference is t(x2-x1+3t), so distinct equal-deck partners have unique t=(x1-x2)/3 nonzero and the unique gap involution. Orient t>=1 and write the pair as (r,s+3t,s,t+u) and (r+t,s,s+3t,u), r,s,u>=0. Every nonsingleton class is therefore a pair, with generating function z^7/[(1-z)^2(1-z^2)(1-z^4)]. Subtraction from binom(n,3) yields the published-conjectured generating function for D_3,3(n); exact pole order gives 3/4 limiting uniquely-decked proportion and 7n^3/48 distinct decks. Independently grouped every binary three-one word of lengths 3..16 from direct scattered-triple counts and verified all pair involutions/counts; finite checks supplement the all-length algebra.
